diagnostics.message: :resource.helm_release.karpenter: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class: explicit depends_on of :module.karpenter is redundant — already implied by attribute references
:resource.null_resource.update_kubeconfig: explicit depends_on of :module.eks is redundant — already implied by attribute references

null_resource.delete_daemonset removes the aws-node VPC CNI DaemonSet, but it has no dependency on null_resource.create_calico_installation. Terraform can therefore delete the existing CNI before the Calico Installation has been created, leaving the cluster without working pod networking.

module.karpenter explicitly depends_on module.self_managed_node_group, but it already depends_on aws_eks_addon.aws_ebs_csi_driver and aws_eks_addon.eks_pod_identity_agent, and both of those add-ons explicitly depend_on module.self_managed_node_group. The direct edge is redundant.

helm_release.karpenter explicitly depends_on data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster, but it already has an implicit dependency on module.karpenter, which explicitly depends_on data.aws_eks_cluster_auth.cluster. The explicit edge is redundant.

helm_release.karpenter explicitly depends_on module.karpenter, but its values reference module.karpenter.service_account and module.karpenter.queue_name, so Terraform already creates the same implicit dependency.

helm_release.karpenter explicitly depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig, but it already depends on module.karpenter, which depends on null_resource.apply_tigera_operator, which in turn depends on null_resource.update_kubeconfig. The explicit edge is redundant.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class explicitly depends_on module.eks, but its triggers and local manifest already reference module.eks security group and cluster outputs, creating the same implicit dependency.
null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class explicitly depends_on module.karpenter, but its triggers and local manifest reference module.karpenter.node_iam_role_arn, so the implicit dependency already exists.

null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class explicitly depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig, but it already depends on module.karpenter, which depends on null_resource.apply_tigera_operator, which depends on update_kubeconfig. The explicit edge is redundant.
null_resource.apply_node_pool explicitly depends_on module.eks, but it already depends_on null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class, which itself depends on module.eks. The explicit edge is redundant.

null_resource.apply_node_pool explicitly depends_on helm_release.karpenter, but it already depends_on null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class, which explicitly depends_on helm_release.karpenter. The explicit edge is redundant.

null_resource.apply_node_pool explicitly depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig, but it already depends_on null_resource.apply_ec2_node_class, which depends on update_kubeconfig. The explicit edge is redundant.
null_resource.delete_daemonset explicitly depends_on module.eks, but it already depends_on null_resource.update_kubeconfig, which depends_on module.eks. The explicit module.eks edge is redundant.
null_resource.update_kubeconfig explicitly depends_on module.eks, but its command references module.eks.cluster_name, so Terraform already infers the dependency implicitly.
